title: The two Morrison's cafeterias
summary: He played both Morrison's, one in town and one on the highway.

blocks.x: How many Morrisons' cafeterias were there in those days? Was there just one or two?
No, there was, I think there was two. I think there was two.
You played in them both or just one?
Yeah, I played in them both.
They had one up in town, you see, and one of them out on the highway. You played the one in town? Yeah, I played for one in town. I can remember that one.
And you were just about getting in remembering size. Not that size. I sat on the back.
Is that the same place as the one that's now? St. Marshall. Still running out of here.
Still running out of here. Still running out of here. Yeah. Still running out of here. Yeah. Oh.
